transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, my sister kind of pushed me to come. I guess... my body just feels a bit out of my control lately. 

Like, a little while ago I was up all night, just pacing around my apartment... making all these notes for a supper club. But lately... I don't know, I'm just really slowed down. My sister says it takes me forever just to get my shoes on now. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling sad or empty lately?
Um... I don't know. I haven't really thought about it. Not... not really sad, I don't think. Just... yeah, I'm not sure.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Not really, no. Um... things just feel kind of flat lately. 

Like... cooking, or playing pickup soccer, listening to music. I know I usually care about that stuff, but... I just can't really make myself feel it right now. So... yeah.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
Um... no. Not really anxious. Just... tired, I guess. Nothing really makes me feel on edge right now. It's just... quiet.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't... I haven't really been doing much of anything to feel guilty about. Just... existing, I guess. So... no.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... I guess... about three months. Yeah, this... this heavy feeling, where everything is just slow. It's been about three months of that.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?

Um... no. Not really. I used to like cooking, taking pictures of food... playing soccer sometimes. But... it all just feels flat now. Like... I know I used to care about those things, but I just can't make myself feel it anymore. So... no, not really.
Do you still enjoy spending time with friends or family?

Um... no. It's... kind of like what I just said. Being around people is... it's just the same. Flat. The stuff that used to keep me steady, like... hanging out, listening to music, or that volunteering I used to do... I just can't make myself care right now. So... no. I don't really see anyone.
Are there any parts of your daily routine that you still look forward to?

No. I... I don't look forward to anything. It's just... like I've been saying. Everything is just... flat. The stuff I normally do, the cooking, the music... it's all just... nothing. I just... I don't care about any of it right now.
Have you noticed any change in your weight lately?

Um... yeah, I guess. My jeans are... they're looser. I haven't been trying to or anything. Just... food tastes like cardboard lately. So I don't really eat much. Maybe just... coffee or a tortilla some days. That's about it.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself lately?
Um... no. I haven't... I haven't had any thoughts like that. No.
Have you had periods of feeling normal in between these episodes of feeling flat and slowed down?
I don't know... I guess? I haven't really kept track. It just... it's just been like this for a while. I don't really remember.
Have you had episodes like this before in your life?
Um... I don't know. Maybe. I haven't really thought about it. I just... it's hard to remember right now. I don't think so.
Have you ever felt this way before in your life?
I mean... like I just said, I don't really know. It's just... it's really hard to think about the past right now. Everything's just kind of a blur. I don't remember.
Have you had any periods in your life where you felt completely normal and not slowed down or flat?
I... I think you just asked me that. I really don't know how else to answer. I just... I can't remember what normal feels like right now.
Have you had more than one episode of feeling this way in your life?
I... look, you keep asking me the exact same thing. I don't know. I really don't. I just... I can't think about it anymore.
Have you had more than one episode of feeling slowed down and flat in your life before this current episode?
I... why do you keep asking me that? I just told you I don't know. I can't remember anything before right now. Please... just stop asking me. My head is too heavy to figure it out.
Is this the first time in your life you've felt this slowed down and flat?
I... I don't have a different answer for you. I don't know if it's the first time. I just... I can't remember. Please...
Have you had any episodes like this before in your life?
I... I don't have anything else to say to that. I already told you I don't know. I can't do this right now... please, just write down whatever you want, I just want to stop talking about it.
Have you had any episodes like this before in your life that lasted less than two months?
I... I just can't. I don't know how long anything lasted. I don't even know what you're looking for anymore. Just... I don't know.
